title: 第25章 收了个小弟第26章 17号技师
content_zh:
“哼！”一声冷哼响起，旁边穿着朴素的那个男生脸上写满了鄙夷，看着唐德，男生仿若自言自语道：“真是丢人现眼。”
这话一下让唐吉德不爽了。一扫刚才那种谄媚的姿态。傲然的脸上带着不屑，沉声道：“王德才，你这是被哪只猫踩到尾巴了。还是你被人羞辱了啊？我说我的，管你屁事啊。”
高山也看向了这个王德才，穿着打扮很朴素，却很干净整洁。这人跟自己其实是一类人。都没有什么钱。出身穷困，却有着极强的自卑感和自尊心。看似傲骨冲天。实际不过是以这么一种方式来掩盖自己的不自信而已。
“好了，都是同学了。说什么呢？阿德，你也别激动，王同学也没有指名道姓说你啊。你这不是自投罗网么？”高山笑着说到。
旁边那个叫小慧的女孩也开口道：“走了，走了。都去领东西去吧。”
倒是旁边另外一个男生开口道：“德才，你别不服气。阿德其实眼光最好。他这么巴结高山是因为他看出来了。你们看，这两个兔子的区别。”
都是学中医的人，对于刮痧也是有所了解的，一看到兔子，王德才甚至还特意上前拨开了兔毛。顿时都不说话了。就在此刻，王德才却是转身看了一眼，然后直接走了出去。
看着众人走出会议室的背影，唐吉德冷哼一声道：“李朝康还算是有些眼光。郭慧和余晓青就差一些了。不过，最牛掰的还是老大你啊。”
说到这，唐吉德那便宜的风格再次呈现了出来，继续一脸谄笑，搓着手：“老大，抱个大腿呗。”
高山心中对于唐吉德倒是有了一些另眼相看的意思，这胖子人际关系处理不错。嘴巴甜、思路快；这些都是很优质的素质。如今看来，这脸皮也厚，这就是成功人士的标配了。这胖子，以后成就不凡啊。既然现在有这种结交的机会，高山也不反对。
他不是圣人，也不是不吃五谷杂粮的神仙。人在凡俗，那就免不了钱财这些东西，虽非必要，可也少不了。如果能有胖子这么一个贴心人帮着处理世俗事物，自己就能安心医门的传承，那自己触摸那巅峰的机会也就更大了。
想到这，高山轻笑着道：“阿德，不就是刮痧技术稍微好一点么？我也没有什么值得你抱大腿的啊。”
“有啊！”唐吉德立刻回应着，然后道：“老大，你想一想，就你这种技术，如果我们要是开一个理疗馆。啧啧，一年火爆、三年连锁、五年就能上市了啊。如果还能引进一些莞式ISO9001的全套体系。啧啧，这日子不要太舒服了。”
“滚！”
研究院的条件还是不错的。都是一室一厅一卫的单人宿舍。这很符合高山的心意，这样一来，自己的修炼也能进行了。要不然还真没法住这里。
一夜无话，第二天众人集合。这时候李胜祖已经等候在了这边了。在他旁边停着一台商务车，一看这车身，众人都懵了。
“没有想到这研究院的福利不错啊。每天还有SPA服务。”唐吉德这小子一脸妖艳贱货的模样，嘿嘿笑着。
李朝康撇了一眼：“哼！你没少去吧。难怪一脸肾虚的模样。”
王德才很是纠结，脸色如同便秘，吞吞吐吐道：“真…真要去啊。”
郭慧和余晓青这两个妹纸的脸色有些难看，郭慧算是比较大胆，小声嘟囔着：“请我们去洗脚么？”

高山看着心中一动，眼前的九座商务车，车身呈粉红色，正对着高山他们的这一面，很是艺术的喷上了养生SPA会所几个字样。抬腿几步，车身的另外一面写着很俗气，却又是无比霸气的几个字——大富豪。
旁边的唐吉德嘀咕着：“这是个人才啊，这都二十一世纪了，还能取出如此清新脱俗，霸气侧目的名字，我唐德一百个服气。”
这厮对自己的名字怨念极大，向来都是自称唐德。
随着众人聚集，商务车车门打开了，一个穿着笔挺西服的年轻男子走了下来，那发型，那身板气势。一看就是领班的架势，身上配备的对讲机更是体现出他的专业。
领班走到了李胜祖的前面，伸出手道：“您是李教授吧。我们老板让我来的。”
李胜祖伸手握了一下，一如既往的带有那么一丝小小的傲娇和矜持。保持着他那种教授的气度。微微颌首算是打了招呼。
然后，李胜祖就转身看着高山等人，又变成了那个冷面的姿态：“接下来你们的学习任务就是去这里上班。专门负责刮痧、拔罐和推拿，什么时候你们能做满了一千个顾客，你们什么时候回来。这段时间，《医学三字经》《本草纲目》《黄帝内经》《汤头歌诀》这都是必须要背记的。”
“什么？上班？”唐吉德瞪大着眼睛。什么鬼，不是去享受么？
李胜祖冷脸一转：“怎么？有意见啊，你可以选择不去。”
李朝康也有些便秘的感觉。去上班，那不就是当技师么？可看到唐吉德的样子，又忍不住道：“唐胖子，就你这鸟样？能不能有人点你还两说呢。你激动个什么劲。搞的跟红牌一样。”
唐吉德歪头一瞅，顶着道：“那谁说得准呢，谁叫我鸟大呢。李朝康，看你这轻车熟路的样子，没少去啊。”
王德才的脸色有些拘谨，甚至是有些慌乱，嘴巴里面还不断念念叨叨起来：“这怎么行，这怎么行啊。我爸妈要知道了，会打死我的。”
高山顿时就笑了起来，而唐吉德却是直接笑出声来了，调侃道：“王德才，你惨了。我听说那些富婆什么的，就喜欢你这种壮实的小伙子了。尤其喜欢红花处男。”
“啊！”王德才又是一惊一乍的叫了一声。
李朝康却是一本正经道：“德才，别听这死胖子胡说。这都是正规场所。咱们是去锻炼按摩技术的。你放心好了。”
余晓青和郭慧还有些扭捏，郭慧的嘴巴都在蠕动。最终还是被余晓青拉住了。看着李胜祖的背影，余晓青低声道：“好了，小慧。你说也没用的。这显然是程院长安排的。”
随着李胜祖离开，年轻经理转过身一脸玩味的看着眼前的这几位大学生，眼神里面呆着的轻蔑，可还得保持一种礼貌的态度，笑着道：“好了，各位大学生，都请上车吧。”
content_en:
"Humph!" A cold snort sounded, and the face of the simple-dressed boy next to him was full of contempt. Looking at Tang De, the boy seemed to be talking to himself: "It's really embarrassing."
These words immediately made Don Quide unhappy. Sweep away that flattering attitude just now. Ao Ran had a look of disdain on his face and said in a deep voice: "Wang Decai, which cat stepped on your tail? Or were you humiliated? I'm telling you, it's none of your business."
Gao Shan also looked at Wang Decai, who was dressed simply but very neatly. This person is actually the same type of person as himself. None of them had much money. Born into poverty, he has a strong sense of inferiority and self-esteem. Seemingly proud. In fact, it is just a way to cover up one's own lack of confidence.
"Okay, we are all classmates. What are you talking about? Ad, don't get excited. Classmate Wang didn't mention you by name. Aren't you throwing yourself into a trap?" Gao Shan said with a smile.
The girl named Xiaohui next to her also said: "Let's go, let's go. Go get your things."
However, another boy next to him said: "Decai, don't be unconvinced. Ade actually has the best judgment. He is so flattering to Gao Shan because he can see it. Look, the difference between these two rabbits."
They are all students of traditional Chinese medicine and are familiar with Gua Sha. When he saw the rabbit, Wang Decai even stepped forward to brush away the rabbit's fur. He stopped talking immediately. At this moment, Wang Decai turned around, took a look, and then walked out directly.
Looking at the backs of everyone walking out of the conference room, Tang Jide snorted coldly and said: "Li Chaokang is quite discerning. Guo Hui and Yu Xiaoqing are not so good. However, the most awesome one is you, the boss."
Having said this, Don Quixote's cheap style showed up again. He continued to smile flatteringly and rubbed his hands: "Boss, give me a hug."
Gao Shan had some special impressions of Tang Jide in his heart. The fat man had good interpersonal relationships. Sweet mouth and quick thinking; these are very good qualities. Nowadays, it seems that he is thick-skinned, which is the standard for successful people. This fat man will achieve great things in the future. Now that there is such an opportunity to make friends, Gao Shan has no objection.
He is not a saint, nor is he a god who does not eat whole grains. When people are in the ordinary world, they cannot avoid things like money. Although they are not necessary, they are indispensable. If he could have a caring person like Fatty to help him deal with worldly matters, he would be able to rest assured about the inheritance of the medical sect, and then his chances of touching the peak would be even greater.
Thinking of this, Gao Shan chuckled and said, "Ade, aren't you just a little better at scraping? I don't have anything worthy of your lap."
"Yes!" Tang Jide responded immediately, and then said: "Boss, think about it, with your technology, if we open a physical therapy center. Tsk tsk, it will be popular in one year, chain in three years, and it will be on the market in five years. If we can also introduce some Dongwan-style ISO9001 complete systems. Tsk tsk, don't be too comfortable today."
"Get out!"
The conditions of the institute are quite good. They are all single dormitories with one bedroom, one living room and one bathroom. This is in line with Gao Shan's wishes. In this way, his own cultivation can be carried out. Otherwise, I really wouldn’t be able to live here.
There was no talking all night, and everyone gathered the next day. At this time, Li Shengzu was already waiting here. There was a commercial car parked next to him. Everyone was stunned when they saw the car body.
"I didn't expect the benefits of this institute to be good. There is also a SPA service every day." Tang Jide, this kid, looked like a coquettish bitch, and he chuckled.
Li Chaokang glanced at him: "Humph! You didn't go less often. No wonder you look like you have a weak kidney."
Wang Decai was very confused, his face looked like he was constipated, and he hesitated: "I really... really want to go."
The two girls, Guo Hui and Yu Xiaoqing, looked a little ugly. Guo Hui was the bolder one and muttered in a low voice: "Invite us to goWash your feet? "
Gao Shan looked at it and his heart moved. The nine-seater business car in front of him had a pink body. The side facing Gao Shan and the others was artistically spray-painted with the words "Health Spa Club". Lifting his legs a few steps, he saw a few tacky but extremely domineering words written on the other side of the car - Rich Man.
Tang Jide next to him muttered: "What a talent. This is the 21st century. He can still come up with such a fresh, refined and domineering name. I, Tang Jide, am completely convinced." "
This guy resented his name very much and always called himself Tang De.
As everyone gathered, the door of the commercial vehicle opened, and a young man in a crisp suit walked out, with that hairstyle and that imposing figure. At first glance, he looks like a foreman, and the walkie-talkie he is equipped with reflects his professionalism.
The foreman walked in front of Li Shengzu, stretched out his hand and said: "You are Professor Li. Our boss asked me to come. "
Li Shengzu reached out and shook it, with a hint of arrogance and reserve as always. Maintaining his professorial demeanor. He opened his mouth slightly to say hello.
Then, Li Shengzu turned to look at Gao Shan and others, and changed his cold-faced attitude: "The next task for you to study is to go to work here. Specializing in gua sha, cupping and massage. When can you have a thousand customers? When will you come back? During this period, the "Three Character Classic of Medicine", "Compendium of Materia Medica", "Huangdi Neijing" and "Song of Soup" must be memorized. "
"What? work? "Don Quide's eyes widened. What the hell, aren't you going to enjoy it?
Li Shengzu turned coldly: "What? If you have any objections, you can choose not to go. "
Li Chaokang also felt a little constipated. If you go to work, isn't that just being a technician? But seeing Tang Jide's appearance, he couldn't help but said: "Fat Tang, are you such a bird? Can someone please give me some advice? How excited are you? It's like a red card. "
Don Quixote tilted his head and said, "Who can say for sure? Who calls me a big bird? Li Chaokang, seeing how you are so familiar with the road, you go there often. "
Wang Decai's face was a little reserved, even a little panicked, and he kept mumbling: "How can this be done? How can this be done? If my parents found out, they would beat me to death. "
Gao Shan immediately laughed, but Tang Jide burst out laughing and said jokingly: "Wang Decai, you are in such a miserable situation. I heard that those rich women and so on like strong young men like you. Especially like the red flower virgin. "
"ah! "Wang Decai shouted again in surprise.
Li Chaokang said seriously: "Decai, don't listen to this fat guy's nonsense. These are all formal places. We are going to practice our massage skills. Don't worry. "
Yu Xiaoqing and Guo Hui were still a little nervous, and Guo Hui's mouth was moving. In the end, he was caught by Yu Xiaoqing. Looking at Li Shengzu's back, Yu Xiaoqing whispered: "Okay, Xiaohui. It's no use what you say. This was obviously arranged by Dean Cheng. "
As Li Shengzu left, the young manager turned around and looked at the college students in front of him with a playful expression, his eyes filled with contempt, but he had to maintain a polite attitude and said with a smile: "Okay, all college students, please get in the car. "
